future_image_policy: Use the immutable corrected runtime image ID recorded by the fresh run; do not treat the historical local image ID as pullable.
json_selection: The scorer requires all extracted JSON answers to agree; it never selects using the expected answer.
code_execution: The same hidden-case scorer runs in bounded no-network/no-GPU runc containers. Module-level computed assignments are allowed for semantic diagnosis; strict scores remain preserved.
scope: Report strict format success and semantic correctness separately for all arms; do not call strict-format losses intelligence losses.
